**Short answer:** For most people, the **Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand** is the best pick. If you have a recent iPhone and want 25W charging, get the **ESR CryoBoost** or the **Nomad Stand One Max**.

## Top picks

- **Best overall: Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED's top pick. It charges at 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and holds the iPhone in portrait or landscape for StandBy. It has a 2-year warranty, and WIRED listed it at $109, with sale prices of about $98 to $80 depending on the retailer. [WIRED review and shop links](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Fastest, premium: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It delivers 25W to the iPhone and has a heavy, stable base. No power adapter is included, and WIRED says you need one rated at 40W. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **25W with a cooling fan: ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 ($99.99).** It includes a 50W adapter, and the fan has an off button for sleeping. The Dealectric page says code PARTNER18 brings the price to about $82, but the store's checkout has the final word. That page is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission if you buy through it. [Buy at ESR via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand) · [Details](https://dealectric.com/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
  - **Caveat:** 25W applies only to the iPhone 17 series, 16 Pro Max and 16 Plus. The iPhone Air, 16 and 16 Pro get 20W, and older iPhones get 15W.
- **Best budget: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (15W).** WIRED calls it the cheapest Qi2-certified 3-in-1 it has found, listed at $80 and $40 on Amazon at the time. The Apple Watch charger detaches, which helps for travel. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options

- **Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable, 25W ($129.99):** It's the tallest and most adjustable of the foldable chargers, works as a desk stand, and folds for travel. It includes a 45W adapter. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html)
- **Nimble Podium (about $130):** Your devices lie flat, so no screens light up at night, and it supports 25W. WIRED notes the Apple Watch charges slowly, so it suits overnight use. [WIRED review](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)
- **Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80):** A compact folding charger for travel at 15W. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/)

## Is 25W worth it?

WIRED's reviewer says 25W makes little difference if you charge overnight, which is why the 15W Belkin is the top pick. Pay extra for 25W only if you often top up quickly during the day and have a supported iPhone.

For AirPods, check that your case supports wireless charging. The base pads charge at about 5W.

I couldn't open the retailer pages here, so prices come from the articles and may have changed. Confirm them at checkout. For Belkin, Nomad, Satechi and Nimble, I only have the review pages above, not direct store links, so use the shop buttons on those pages.
